slots.hook: Skin starting to feel less firm along the jaw? You don't need surgery to lift it.
slots.brief: Introduce Laser Lift as the hero treatment: non-surgical skin tightening that stimulates the skin's own collagen. Who it suits — women 35+ noticing early laxity at the jawline and lower face. What a session involves and how it feels, grounded strictly in the treatments page copy. CTA: book a consultation.

slots.hook: "Fillers always look fake." Only the bad ones you can spot.
slots.brief: Bust the overfilled-face myth. A medically-led liquid facelift restores lost structure subtly — the best work is invisible. Emphasise assessment-first approach and natural outcomes; never mock the reader for the belief. CTA: consultation for an honest opinion.

slots.hook: The most important part of any treatment happens before it: the consultation.
slots.brief: Why medically-led matters. Nafisa's consultation-first ethos: assessment, honest suitability advice, safety standards, no treatment sold on the day it isn't right for. Position the consultation as the product. CTA: book a consultation.

slots.hook: Noticing lines settling in around your forehead or eyes? Start with a conversation, not a treatment.
slots.brief: POM-SENSITIVE — consultation-led only. Explain what causes dynamic expression lines and why a proper medical consultation is the right starting point for treating them. No drug or brand names, no prices, no offers. CTA: book a consultation to discuss lines and wrinkles.

slots.hook: Never been to an aesthetics clinic? Here's exactly what your first visit looks like.
slots.brief: Walk through the first visit step by step: welcome, skin assessment, honest discussion of options, no-pressure next steps. Aimed at first-timers who are nervous or sceptical. Reduce fear of the unknown. CTA: book that first consultation.

slots.hook: One product protects every result we ever achieve together: SPF.
slots.brief: August sun edition. Why daily SPF is the single non-negotiable for skin quality and for protecting treatment results — holiday sun, UK sun, all of it. Practical, no product-pushing. CTA: ask about skin advice at your next visit.

slots.hook: Not filler. Not a laser. Polynucleotides work on your skin quality itself.
slots.brief: Explain polynucleotides: skin regeneration and quality rather than volume — what they are, who they suit (crepey skin, under-eyes, overall skin health), typical course structure. Ground in treatments page copy. CTA: consultation.

slots.hook: "Microneedling is just needles rolled over your face." RF microneedling is a different treatment entirely.
slots.brief: Bust the derma-roller confusion. RF microneedling pairs microneedling with radiofrequency energy for tightening and texture — controlled depth, numbing for comfort, realistic downtime. Correct the 'it's agony' and 'only for scarring' assumptions. CTA: consultation.

slots.hook: Sometimes the best advice I can give is "not yet".
slots.brief: Honest suitability. Nafisa's first-person account of turning treatments down when they're not right — wrong treatment, wrong time, or skincare first. This is what medically-led means in practice. Builds trust through restraint. CTA: come for an honest assessment.

slots.hook: Moisturiser works on the surface. Skin boosters hydrate from within it.
slots.brief: Explain skin boosters: deep hydration and glow rather than volume — how they differ from filler, who they suit (dull, dehydrated, tired-looking skin), what a course looks like. Ground in treatments page copy. CTA: consultation.

slots.hook: The treatment is half the result. What you do in the two weeks after is the other half.
slots.brief: Aftercare matters. What good aftercare looks like (SPF, gentle skincare, following the plan) and how PureMed supports clients between appointments. Realistic results timelines — good outcomes are a partnership. CTA: soft, ask-a-question style.

slots.hook: Laser Lift results don't appear overnight — and that's exactly why they look natural.
slots.brief: Second Laser Lift angle: the results timeline. Collagen remodelling takes weeks — set expectations for what changes and when, in ranges consistent with the treatments page. Realistic framing is the trust play; results vary by individual. CTA: consultation.

slots.hook: Thinking about feeling your best for autumn events? The time to start is now — here's why.
slots.brief: Planning-ahead post (NOT urgency): skin treatments take weeks to show full results, so September/October occasions mean starting conversations in August. Factual timeline framing, zero pressure language, no offers. CTA: book a consultation to plan.

slots.hook: "You'd always know if someone had work done." You've almost certainly complimented someone who has.
slots.brief: Second liquid facelift myth: detectability. Subtle, medically-led work reads as 'well-rested', not 'done' — that's the goal, not the exception. Reinforce bespoke, staged approach. Distinct angle from Aug 3 (fake looks vs detectability). CTA: consultation.

slots.hook: One clinic. One practitioner. The same face at every appointment — on purpose.
slots.brief: Meet Nafisa / continuity of care. The deliberate choice of a small medically-led clinic: the person who assesses you treats you, every time, and carries your full history. Warm, personal, first-person where natural. CTA: book a consultation.

slots.hook: Prevention or correction? With expression lines, the honest answer depends on your face — not your age.
slots.brief: POM-SENSITIVE — consultation-led only. Second anti-wrinkle angle, distinct from Aug 7: the prevention-vs-correction conversation and why it's individual (skin, expression patterns, goals — not a birthday number). No drug or brand names, no prices, no offers. CTA: consultation to talk it through.
